title: False dealing teaches the body to lie
summary: The shabad does not treat false profit as a private mistake; it says repeated crooked dealing makes mind and body false and leaves peace out of reach.
takeaway: Refuse the deal that makes the whole self false.
lifeApplication: When a shortcut asks you to call greed necessity, step back before the hand moves and choose the peace that truth can bear.

source.shortMeaning: Praise is the true merchandise; without truth as capital, false dealing makes mind and body false.
source.lifeApplication: Notice the moment a bargain asks for inner dishonesty, and let truth end the transaction.

evidence.coreClaim: Praise is the true merchandise; without truth as capital, false dealing makes mind and body false.
evidence.turn: Name the crooked bargain before it trains the body to participate in falsehood.
evidence.practicalImplication: When a shortcut asks you to call greed necessity, step back before the hand moves and choose the peace that truth can bear.
